responsibility: Exposes the slice to the Workbench as a JSON control surface over the Layer-2 service.
reads: the request method, path and body handed to it
execution_location: in-process dispatcher, optionally wrapped by a loopback-only, deliberately single-threaded stdlib HTTP server that carries no caller identity and no authentication proof
failure_boundary: fail_closed — any refusal from below is returned as an error payload with its code and never softened into a success, and an unknown route returns the route list rather than guessing
recovery_behavior: Stateless request dispatcher holding no session, so it serves correct answers from authority immediately after any restart
replacement_contract: A replacement must route every state-changing route through the Layer-2 Conductor and never through a Workbench mutation method, reach read-only authority only through the Layer-2 service and its projections, carry no SQL and no adapter, accept on each route exactly that route's declared string fields and no caller-supplied actor or classification, expose no evidence-admission or objective-mutation seam, expose the assurance increment through GET routes only and never a route that freezes, verifies, reviews or promotes, and keep the dispatcher callable without a socket
evidence_produced: HTTP-shaped status and body per request
the error code of every refusal it passes through
read-only assurance progress, including the reported A-O order reconciliation, with no state-changing assurance route in the surface
